title: 'Chapapote', the New Film by Daniel Sánchez Arévalo and Starring Tamar Novas, Begins Filming
summary: Netflix has announced the start of filming and cast of 'Chapapote,' the new film by Daniel Sánchez Arévalo ('Collision Course,' 'Band Together').
body_markdown:
Entertainment


03 November 2026


Global


Spain


Link copied to clipboard


[DOWNLOAD FIRST IMAGE](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/f57b43a7-8acf-4e1c-bee3-7193a5633556)


Netflix has announced the start of filming and cast of


Chapapote


, the new film by


Daniel Sánchez Arévalo


(


Collision Course, Band Together


). Produced by Bambú Producciones, the comedy stars


Tamar Novas


(


The sea inside, Gangs of Galicia


), with


Carlos Blanco


(


The Asunta case, Riot Police


),


María Vázq


uez (


Matria, Band Together


), Alexandra Jiménez (


Proxies, Go Team!


),


Irene Arcos


(


The Pier, Alpha Males


) and


Fer Fraga


(


Unprotected: Murder in Galicia


) rounding out the cast, alongside a special appearance by


Antonio Durán “Morris”


(


Fariña, Animal


).


The year is 2002. The oil tanker


Prestige


breaks in two off the Galician coast, and an oil slick covers its beaches. All of them, that is, except one: the beach in the small town of Agarimo. What should be great news for its residents ends up becoming a problem. Although the oil spill hasn’t reached their beach, they can’t go out fishing, they receive no aid, and none of the thousands of volunteers pouring into neighboring towns come their way. With businesses empty and the future looking bleaker by the day, the people of Agarimo come up with an idea that is as outlandish as it is desperate: if the oil spill won’t reach their beach, perhaps they’ll have to bring it there themselves.


Directed by


Daniel Sánchez Arévalo


(


Seventeen, Band Together


),


Chapapote


is based on an original idea by


Ramón Campos


(


Band Together, Collision, The Asunta Case


), who wrote the screenplay with Sánchez Arévalo and also serves as executive producer. The crew includes


Rafa García


as director of photography,


Eva Camino


as costume designer,


Antonio Pereira


as production designer,


Miguel Sanz


as editor and


Federico Jusid


as composer of the original score.


About Bambú Producciones


Bambú Producciones is a production company led by screenwriter and producer Ramón Campos. Since its inception in 2008, Bambú has established itself in international markets as a leading European production company, thanks to titles such as Grand Hotel,


Velvet


,


Fariña


,


Cable Girls


or


The Asunta Case


. In addition to television series, Bambú also produces documentaries (


The Alcassèr Murders


,


The Asunta case


and


Hunting a Monster


) and films (


Malasaña 32


,


A Widow’s Game


,


Band Together


and Collision Course).
